title: Symbolic regression and ML potentials guide a ferroelectric Dion-Jacobson perovskite
summary: Starting from 11 known ferroelectric Dion-Jacobson 2D hybrid perovskites, symbolic regression defined a descriptor-bounded region, and similarity-guided expansion with chemical filtering reduced 83,924 molecules to 1012 candidate spacers. Machine-learned interatomic-potential relaxation found 338 candidates retaining Dion-Jacobson connectivity, and sequential prioritization selected s-2-fluorobutane-1,4-diamine. A PbI4-based perovskite with this spacer was synthesized and showed experimentally confirmed ferroelectric switching. The result is a single compound, described by the authors as a proof of concept.
ai_technology: Symbolic regression and machine-learned interatomic-potential relaxation for spacer screening

evidence.tested: Synthesis of the selected compound and measurement of ferroelectric switching.
evidence.unknown: Performance of other candidates and generality beyond one compound; full text not reviewed.
